description: Elections Commission - L. D. G. Perera of the Dehiwala-Mount Lavinia Municipal Council has vacated her office of the member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - P. Seetha of the Godakawela Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated her office of the member of Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - P. M. P. C. K. Pannila of the Kalawana Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of local government bodies due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about candidate status and office vacancies.
